description.value: Coastal Rainforest Safaris is an Indigenous-led wildlife tour company operating out of Port Hardy, offering day and multi-day boat expeditions into the wildlife-rich waters of northern Vancouver Island and the Great Bear Rainforest. Founded in 2020 and co-owned by Mike Willie and Andrew Jones, the company is recognized by Indigenous Tourism BC and weaves Kwakwakaʼwakw cultural interpretation into every tour. A cycling visitor stopping in Port Hardy could book a memorable half-day whale-watching or sea-otter excursion as a complement to their coastal touring route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and detailed, confirming Coastal Rainforest Safaris is a real, operating wildlife tour company departing from Port Hardy on Northern Vancouver Island, with 2026 tour schedules listed. The OSM record has no tags, address, or phone, so all information comes from the website. The website content is entirely focused on marine wildlife tours (whale watching, sea otters, birding) and contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any land-based cyclist amenities.
concerns: No physical address listed in OSM or on the website; departure point appears to be Port Hardy but exact dock/staging location is not specified.
No phone number available in OSM or confirmed from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating attraction with 2026 tour schedules published; a notable Indigenous-led wildlife experience that would be of genuine interest to touring cyclists visiting Port Hardy.
enrichment_extras.notes: A German-language guest review on the birding page mentions lunch is included on tours, suggesting on-vessel food service, but this does not constitute a land-based café or food amenity.

peak.label: peak wildlife diversity — whales, otters, seabirds all active
